item.title: Provisioning Everpure Cloud Azure Native Resources with Terraform
item.description: This post walks through a complete Terraform example that provisions an Everpure Cloud Azure Native storage pool, volume group, and volume, then automatically mounts it to an Azure VM over iSCSI.
